{{Quote|The Rakata took me when I was very small. "Tau" is the only word of my native language I recall. It means&mdash; "soul."|Tau, explaining his name to Shae Koda|<ref name="ForceWar2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:Young-Tau-2.png|thumb|right|200px|Tau only recalled one word from his native language following his abduction by the Rakata.]]
A '''native language''' was used by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual who was abducted and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] at a young age and given the name [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]]. He became a [[Force Hound]], and at some point, Xesh chose to secretly rename himself after the only word from his language which he recalled: Tau, which meant "[[Soul/Legends|soul]]." Tau felt that the name captured the essence of his being and was unrepresented in the [[Rakata (language)|Rakatan language]]. The Force Hound revealed his secret name to no one until<ref name="ForceWar2" /> approximately [[25,792 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'' dates itself to [[25,793 BBY]] and takes place while [[Daegen Lok]] is still [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Bogan]]. According to author {{Twitter|timlebbon|status/325244030705340417|[[Tim Lebbon]]|quote=@DigiFluid Sure, it's pretty much at the same time as the Force Storm arc.|archivedate=20200813210755}}, the events of the novel take place roughly concurrently to the events of [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm|''Force Storm'']], the first arc of the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi|''Dawn of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. Lok leaves Bogan during the second arc, [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|''The Prisoner of Bogan'']] and the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|first issue]] of the subsequent [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force War|''Force War'']] arc states that one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] has passed since the previous arc's events. Therefore, the events of [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 2]], which include [[Tau (individual)|Tau's]] confession of his true name, must take place in approximately [[25,792 BBY]].</ref> when he confessed it to his lover, the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Shae Koda]], following her profession of love to him on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shikaakwa]] in the [[Tython system]].<ref name="ForceWar2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tau's native language was mentioned in [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 2]], a comic in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force War|''Force War'']] arc of the series ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]''. The comic was written by [[John Ostrander]]<ref name="ForceWar2" /> and first published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 18]], [[2013]].<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/exclusive-star-wars-comics-preview-december-titles-and-february-graphic-novels|text=Exclusive ''Star Wars'' Comics Preview: December Titles and February Graphic Novels}}</ref>
